items.title: Dinosaur Battle
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Choose your dinosaurs, pick the arena and start an epic fight! The dinosaurs are ready, are you? 
Simulate epic battles between various dino species! Will the T-Rex win? Or perhaps the Triceratops? Let’s find out in the Dinosaur Battle! 

+ 15+ Dinosaurs
+ 4 different arenas!
+ Epic fights!

- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Random Drops World
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
This world has a twist! Start off in this beautiful modern town, but everytime you break a block, you never know what you will get! Will you succeed in the challenge and defeat the Ender Dragon?

+Every drop is random!
+By FALL Studios & MatzX

items.title: One Block
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Skyblock is too easy for you? Then try your hand at the One Block Challenge!
Whenever you mine the block you get a random item or block! Will you manage to equip yourself and win the battle against the Ender Dragon?

- Skyblock experience!
- Have fun playing!
items.changelog:
- Updated the One Block with all new blocks and item drops up to version 26.30!
- Added a lot of new islands and biomes to the world!

items.title: Pure Nature
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
If you've ever wanted to blend in with the environ--wait, where'd you go?! With this skin pack that uses some of nature’s most common textures, you can become one with the forest, the desert, or any other biome.

- Includes 8 unique skins for any environment
- From cacti and dirt, to ice and lava, there are plenty of options!
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios

items.title: Sci-Fi Villains
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Every hero needs a villain, and we've rallied together the meanest group of scoundrels perfect for ruling any planet in this skin pack of sci-fi villains. With overlords that go by Lord Strife or Khaal'tul, the Brute, you'll rule with an iron fist!

- Includes 10 ghastly skins!
- Armor sets show off details perfect for any villain
- By Thezi & Pathway Studios

items.title: Deep Dark Cave Creatures
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Lurking deep in the caves are monstrosities that condemn the light and harbor their will towards the collection of poor cave explorers. Their legion of sculk is always growing and is always ready to sneak up on the unsuspecting. Join the ranks of these monsters by wearing one of these 9 skins.

-By Kiptrix & Pathways Studios

items.title: Blocktange
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description: Step back into history with Blocktange, a tribute to a Dutch relic from the 1500s! Blocktange features a massive survival spawn that is beginner-friendly with plenty of resources to get you started! Not a noob? Then venture off on your own into the beautiful world around you! Start your survival adventure today with Blocktange by Block Perfect Studios!

items.title: Horror Glitches
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
How can you block the attacks of these horrors when they spawn from your thoughts? They feed on your fear and hide in the darkness waiting for a chance to strike! Are you lucky enough to survive their attacks or will you give in and become one of these mobs?

- Includes fourteen horror glitch skins!
- Keep your feelings sky high to fight their power!

items.title: Skulls in Suits
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
These undead businessmen are dying to make a deal with you! After wheeling and dealing in the bone block market they're here for your gold ingots and blocks! Are you lucky enough to secure the deal of your life and make out with all the emeralds?

- Includes eleven skeletons in suit skins!
- The sky is the limit in their dealing, can you secure the contract?
